notes.title: New Agate Visual Novel Celestia: Chain of Fate is releasing 12th September!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Principals!

A new game from Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story developer Agate is about to drop! [b]Celestia: Chain of Fate[/b] releases on September 12th, 2024 on Steam! Enter this fantasy-romance visual novel with a compelling narrative about Angelus, Daemons, and Half Bloods over 20 chapters and 23 alternate endings! 

[b]Wishlist Now on Steam! - [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2791850/Celestia_Chain_of_Fate/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2791850/Celestia_Chain_of_Fate/[/url] 

[previewyoutube=KvyrI407-60;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]About the Game:
[/b]The perfect life you’ve known as a daughter of a Duke is about to change forever. With the revelation of your new hybrid identity, as a descendant of Angelus and Daemon, you must learn to live in a new world.

Uncover the secrets of your family history and learn to control the magical abilities you hold. Along the way, you'll have the chance to develop relationships with one of three romanceable characters, each with their own unique traits and personalities.

It’s down to you to hold your friendships and advance your love interests while also prioritising your education. Remember not to neglect your studies as you'll need to overcome a series of challenges to graduate!

notes.title: Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story 2 is out now!
notes.notes:
Attention, esteemed Principals! We have some exciting news for you.

You can now play the full version of Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story 2 on Steam! And that's not all! You can also play the game on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch! We are very grateful to all the devoted fans who have tirelessly supported the team throughout the game's development.

Now, we must confess that there's a slight twist in the tale. The Xbox One and Xbox Series S|X players and our avid Japanese gaming community might have to wait a little bit longer because we still need to improve some things. But fear not, Principals! Our dedicated team is working hard to ensure that you'll soon be able to enjoy the thrilling world of Valthiria on your desired platforms, delivering an experience that will surpass all your expectations.

Once again, we express our most profound appreciation for your unwavering patience and support. Get ready to enter the world of Valthiria, and may your school produce heroes who will be remembered in Valthiria forever!

With many thanks, 
Agate & PQube

Watch the trailer here: [previewyoutube=l4pqOzE8cNY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Fast forward, Indonesian language support update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are pleased to announce the latest update for Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story! This update adds two much-requested features: a fast forward option and the complete game localisation in Indonesian, as well as a number of smaller bug fixes.

Here is the complete change log:

[u]Added[/u]
    1. New fast forward feature to speed up time progression in game 
    2. Added Indonesian translation, which can be changed from the language setting

[u]Changed[/u]
    1. Changed "Kayla's Request" mission difficulty from 1 star to 2 stars
    2. Changed "Blue Banquet" mission difficulty from 2 stars to 3 stars

[u]Fixed[/u]
    1. Fixed a bug where the portal to academy confirmation dialog didn't show a selection marker
    2. Fixed a bug where some text was not displayed correctly according to the chosen language
    3. Fixed a bug where the mission name was not displayed correctly according to the chosen language
    4. Fixed a bug where student names were not displayed correctly in Asian languages
    5. Fixed some typos in Japanese
    6. Fixed wrong images being displayed in tutorial scenes
    7. Fixed incomplete button guides during student management

And here's a message from the development team at Agate:

Halo Valthirians!

Terima kasih banyak sudah mendukung Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story. Sejak game ini diluncurkan, kami mendapat berbagai saran untuk meningkatkan pengalaman bermain. Setelah beberapa kali kami meluncurkan update untuk memperbaiki bug, update kali ini cukup signifikan karena membawa dua fitur baru yang diminta oleh sejumlah pemain: mempercepat waktu dan lokalisasi dalam Bahasa Indonesia!

Fitur mempercepat waktu memungkinkanmu mengurangi waktu tunggu di layar akademi. Sekarang kamu bisa fokus ke bermain bagian yang serunya dan tidak perlu lagi menunggu terlalu lama sampai pembangunan selesai!

Selain itu, salah satu fitur yang paling banyak diminta adalah Valthirian Arc dalam Bahasa Indonesia. Awalnya kami mengira bahwa kebanyakan pemain akan berasal dari luar negeri, sehingga tidak memasukkan pilihan Bahasa Indonesia dari awal. Ternyata antusiasme teman-teman sebangsa cukup kuat, sehingga akhirnya kami menambahkannya. Semoga dengan adanya game dengan bahasa nusantara, semakin banyak game berkualitas global yang akan dibuat oleh anak-anak bangsa!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33236380/54554dc481df0bed97c6de6e880dec9a51ca39e1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Manage an adventuring academy in Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story, out now
notes.notes:
I’ve always had a soft spot for ambitious genre mash-ups, and Agate’s Valthirian Arc: Hero School – released today – aims high, asking players to both manage a hero training facility and lead its students in real-time RPG combat. There’s campus buildings to be placed, gear to be crafted, students to be nurtured and dragons to be slain all while balancing the books and even engaging in a little politics. If it didn’t look so adorable, it’d be almost intimidating. Take a peek at the game in action in the launch trailer below, plus a (rather old) demo.
